description: Stressed caller, frequent interruptions and overlapping speech; facts scattered across turns.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Horizon Assurance claims, this is Emma, how can I—

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yes hello, sorry, I've just had an accident, like, just now, well this morning, I'm still a bit—

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay, take a breath, sir, are you safe right now?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yeah, yeah, I'm on the pavement. The van just, it came out of nowhere, it hit my door.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Alright. Can I start with your name?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Thomas. Thomas Keller. K E L L E R.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thank you Mr Keller, and do you have your policy—

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: The policy, hang on, it's on the card, F N X, five five one, nine three zero.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: FNX-551930. Great. When exactly did this—

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Like twenty minutes... no, more, it was around quarter past eight this morning.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So about 8:15 today. And where are you?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Rue de Rivoli, right in front of the Louvre-Rivoli metro exit, in Paris.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And your car's registration?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: It's the Clio, F K, nine zero two, L M.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: FK-902-LM. What's damaged?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: The driver's door is completely caved in and the side mirror got torn off, it's lying on the road—

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Are you hurt at all? Is anybody—

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: My wrist, my wrist hurts, I think it's sprained, I put my hand out. The other driver is fine, he got out.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay, please get that checked. The other driver, do you have his details?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yeah he's a delivery guy, Karim Haddad, the van is E Z three three one Q B, he says it's with AXA.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: EZ-331-QB, AXA. Did the police come?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: No, no police, we're filling in the constat together now.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay. Did anyone see what happened?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: A cyclist stopped, her name's Léa Rousseau, but I didn't get her number, she's gone—

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: No problem. Last thing, a number to call you back?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Zero seven, eighty-one, twenty-two, ninety, thirteen.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: 07 81 22 90 13. Take care Mr Keller, we'll call you back within the hour.
